sources.title: yugabyte-db: LICENSE.md
supports: The YugabyteDB core database (src/yb, src/postgres, java, python, bin and others) is under the Apache License 2.0

YugabyteDB Anywhere (managed/, troubleshoot/) is under the Polyform Free Trial License 1.0.0, which permits evaluation for up to 32 consecutive calendar days; production use needs a commercial license

sources.title: cockroach: LICENSE (CockroachDB Software License)
supports: The software may not be operated without a license key except for Limited Non-Production Use
Limited Non-Production Use is design, prototyping, testing or development in non-production internal environments during the Introductory Period, or a database that runs solely on a single node
The software shares telemetry with the licensor unless the use is limited non-production or the license key allows it to be disabled

sources.title: CockroachDB Licensing FAQs
supports: Enterprise Free is free of charge for businesses with less than $10M in annual revenue, counted across the parent company and all affiliates; government entities do not qualify
A cluster with no license key has a 7-day grace period, after which the number of concurrent open SQL transactions is limited to 5
Enterprise Free clusters are throttled after 7 days without sending telemetry
Single-node clusters for development use are not throttled

sources.title: CockroachDB: Production Checklist
supports: At least 3 nodes with the default 3-way replication factor to tolerate the failure of one node
A minimum of 8 vCPUs is recommended, and no fewer than 4 vCPUs per node is strongly recommended
The default maximum clock offset is 500 ms; a node shuts itself down when its clock is out of sync with at least half of the other nodes by 80% of it

sources.title: CockroachDB: PostgreSQL Compatibility
supports: CockroachDB is compatible with version 3.0 of the PostgreSQL wire protocol

sources.title: tidb: LICENSE
supports: TiDB is under the Apache License, Version 2.0

sources.title: TiDB: Overview
supports: TiDB is compatible with the MySQL protocol, common features of MySQL, and the MySQL ecosystem

sources.title: TiDB: Software and Hardware Recommendations
supports: A production cluster needs at least 2 TiDB, 3 PD and 3 TiKV instances

sources.title: YugabyteDB releases
supports: v2025.2 is a long-term support (LTS) series and v2026.1 a standard-term (STS) series; the next LTS, v2026.2, is planned for the end of 2026

sources.title: YugabyteDB v2025.2 release notes
supports: v2025.2.7.0, build 2025.2.7.0-b107, was released on October 5, 2026
Archives are published for darwin-arm64, el8-aarch64 and linux-x86_64 at software.yugabyte.com/releases/2025.2.7.0/
sources.note: The SHA-256 of each archive was read from the `.sha` file next to it on software.yugabyte.com.

sources.title: YugabyteDB Quick start: macOS
supports: The macOS archives are checked against a `.sha` file published next to them
yugabyted needs Python 3.11; port 7000 collides with AirPlay Receiver on macOS Monterey and later
The local setup is a single-host setup intended for development and learning

sources.title: yugabyted reference
supports: yugabyted can be used for production deployments; yb-master and yb-tserver can also be administered directly
`yugabyted backup` and `restore` to S3 need the node started with --backup_daemon=true and YB Controller installed, and are not supported on macOS

sources.title: Manual deployment: Start YB-Masters
supports: yb-master is started with --master_addresses, --rpc_bind_addresses, --fs_data_dirs and the --placement_cloud, --placement_region, --placement_zone flags, or with --flagfile
The number of nodes running YB-Masters, and of addresses in --master_addresses, must equal the replication factor
The masters discover each other and elect a Raft leader; the page tells you to add the start command to cron so the process is restarted if it goes down

sources.title: Manual deployment: System configuration
supports: chrony is the preferred NTP implementation; a YB-TServer or YB-Master shuts down when it detects clock skew larger than --max_clock_skew_usec (500 ms by default)
On cloud providers the provider's link-local time service should be used
Recommended limits include 1048576 open files and 12000 user processes; transparent hugepages should be enabled; on virtual machines vm.swappiness=0 and vm.max_map_count=262144
ClockBound is supported on AWS and optional; PTP is currently available only for AWS

sources.title: Deployment checklist
supports: The default replication factor is 3; with it a cluster tolerates one node failure, and needs at least as many nodes, YB-Masters and YB-TServers as the RF
Minimum 2 cores and 2 GB RAM; for production YSQL 16+ cores and 64 GB+ RAM
x86 and ARM (aarch64) are supported; SSDs are required, XFS recommended, noatime on data drives
On AWS use the M instance family and gp3 volumes of at least 250 GB; avoid T2 instance types
Nodes communicate on 7100 (YB-Master RPC) and 9100 (YB-TServer RPC); 5433 serves YSQL clients; 7000 is the YB-Master admin UI

sources.title: Operating system support
supports: Amazon Linux 2023 is supported in v2024.2.3 and later; AlmaLinux 8 is the default for YugabyteDB Anywhere-deployed nodes

sources.title: Create server certificates
supports: Each node needs ca.crt, node.<commonName>.crt and node.<commonName>.key, where the common name is the node's address
The example issues the root and the node certificates with openssl for 3650 days; the page does not describe rotation

sources.title: Enable server-to-server encryption
supports: use_node_to_node_encryption and use_client_to_server_encryption default to false; allow_insecure_connections defaults to true and, set to false, keeps any service with unencrypted communication from joining
certs_dir names the directory with the certificates

sources.title: Transaction isolation levels
supports: YSQL supports Serializable, Snapshot and Read Committed; Snapshot maps to the SQL Repeatable Read level
For manually deployed universes yb_enable_read_committed_isolation defaults to false, and Read Committed falls back to the stricter Snapshot isolation

sources.title: Concurrency control
supports: With wait queues a transaction waits for the conflicting ones to finish, then proceeds only if they made no conflicting permanent change, and otherwise aborts
A statement that is the first of its transaction is retried internally with a later snapshot

sources.title: Transaction retries in YSQL
supports: 40001 (serialization failure) and 40P01 (deadlock detected) are to be handled by rolling back and retrying the whole transaction with backoff
A COMMIT must not be retried blindly, because it is unclear whether the commit happened

sources.title: Synchronous replication in DocDB
supports: A tablet has as many peers as the replication factor; they form a Raft group and elect a leader
A write is applied after its Raft log entry is replicated to and persisted on a majority of the peers
Tolerating f fault domains needs a replication factor of at least 2f + 1
Only the tablet leader processes user-facing reads and writes by default; the stated recovery time after a zone outage is 3 seconds

sources.title: Transactions overview
supports: Every update is a transaction; timestamps come from hybrid logical clocks that combine physical time and a logical counter, and nodes exchange them on every RPC
Conflict resolution between concurrent transactions depends on the maximum clock skew in the cluster

sources.title: Hash and range sharding
supports: Tables are split into shards called tablets; the primary key of a row decides its tablet
Hash sharding spreads rows evenly over the 2-byte hash space 0x0000 to 0xFFFF; range sharding keeps rows in primary key order

sources.title: YB-Master service
supports: YB-Master keeps the system metadata, the map from tablets to servers, balances load and re-replicates the data of a failed server; it is not in the I/O path
The masters form a Raft group of their own

sources.title: YugabyteDB node-postgres smart driver
supports: @yugabytedb/pg is built on node-postgres and adds cluster-aware and topology-aware connection load balancing (loadBalance, topologyKeys, ybServersRefreshInterval)

sources.title: Change cluster configuration
supports: Moving to new nodes uses change_blacklist ADD, get_load_move_completion, and change_master_config ADD_SERVER / REMOVE_SERVER one master at a time
A new master is started without master_addresses and joins through ADD_SERVER; tserver_master_addrs must then be updated on every tablet server

sources.title: Replace a failed YB-Master
supports: The replacement is started with an empty --master_addresses; if the failed master is already dead, REMOVE_SERVER comes before ADD_SERVER
--tserver_master_addrs has to be updated on every YB-TServer to the new set of masters

sources.title: Replace a failed YB-TServer
supports: Start a new YB-TServer in the same placement, blacklist the failed one, wait for get_load_move_completion to reach 100, then remove the blacklist entry
The master leader marks a server DEAD after it has not responded for one minute

sources.title: Upgrade YugabyteDB
supports: A rolling upgrade restarts the YB-Masters one at a time, then the YB-TServers one at a time, pausing at least 60 seconds between nodes
It is finalized with `yb-admin promote_auto_flags` and `yb-admin upgrade_ysql`; after finalizing there is no rollback, and the monitoring phase should not exceed two days
post_install.sh is run after the archive is extracted

sources.title: Backup and restore
supports: The methods are export and import with SQL scripts, distributed snapshots, and point-in-time recovery

sources.title: Distributed snapshots for YSQL
supports: Snapshots are per database and use hard links on the cluster's own volumes; they do not protect against file system corruption or hardware failure
Moving a snapshot off the cluster is manual: the schema with ysql_dump, the metadata with export_snapshot, and the snapshot directories of every tablet copied by hand

sources.title: Metrics
supports: Prometheus metrics are served at :7000/prometheus-metrics (YB-Master), :9000/prometheus-metrics (YB-TServer) and :13000/prometheus-metrics (YSQL)

sources.title: yb-admin reference
supports: list_all_masters, list_all_tablet_servers, get_universe_config and change_master_config exist with the syntax used in this chapter
A cluster with TLS needs --certs_dir_name pointing at the directory with the root certificate
sources.note: The page was read only as far as the tool returned it; modify_placement_info was confirmed from the usage text of the pinned binary and by running it on the local cluster.

sources.title: AWS Price List: AWSDataTransfer, ap-northeast-1
supports: APN1-DataTransfer-Regional-Bytes: $0.01 per GB, regional data transfer in/out/between EC2 AZs (SKU RVH645383RKU285J, published 2026-09-16)

sources.title: Understanding data transfer charges
supports: For a data transfer within a Region a resource is charged for both inbound and outbound traffic, so each transfer shows as two DataTransfer-Regional-Bytes line items

sources.title: Precision clock and time synchronization on your EC2 instance
supports: The Amazon Time Sync Service is available to all EC2 instances, uses satellite-connected and atomic reference clocks in each Region, and smears leap seconds

sources.title: Amazon EC2 T4g instances
supports: t4g.medium has 2 vCPUs and 4 GiB of memory, with a baseline of 20% per vCPU; T4g instances start in unlimited mode by default

sources.title: Cloudflare D1
supports: D1 is Cloudflare's managed, serverless database with SQLite's SQL semantics; pricing is based only on query and storage costs

sources.title: Vercel Storage overview
supports: Vercel's own storage products are Blob and Global Config; databases are provisioned through the Vercel Marketplace from providers such as Neon, Upstash and Supabase

definition.ja: 複数の写しのあいだで、書き込みの順序を 1 つに決めるための合意の手順。1 つがリーダーになって書き込みを受け、過半数の写しに記録されたものだけを確定とする。
definition.en: A consensus protocol that makes several copies agree on one order of writes. One copy is the leader and takes the writes; a write counts only once a majority of the copies have recorded it.

definition.ja: 写しの半分より多い数。3 つなら 2 つ。過半数が生きているあいだだけ、リーダーを選べて、書き込みを確定できる。
definition.en: More than half of the copies: two of three. Only while a majority is alive can a leader be elected and a write be made final.

definition.ja: YugabyteDB がテーブルを分けた 1 かけら。行は主キーでどれか 1 つの tablet に入り、tablet ごとに写しの組（Raft のグループ）がある。
definition.en: One piece of a table in YugabyteDB. A row belongs to one tablet by its primary key, and each tablet has its own set of copies (a Raft group).

definition.ja: 1 つの tablet の写しの数。3 なら、ノードを 1 つ失っても過半数が残る。
definition.en: The number of copies of each tablet. With three, a majority remains after one node is lost.

definition.ja: ノードどうしの時計の差。YugabyteDB は時刻をトランザクションの順序づけに使うので、差が上限（既定で 500 ミリ秒）を超えたノードは自分で止まる。
definition.en: The difference between the clocks of two nodes. YugabyteDB orders transactions with timestamps, so a node whose clock is off by more than the limit (500 ms by default) stops itself.

tiers.description: $0.01 per GB - regional data transfer - in/out/between EC2 AZs or using elastic IPs or ELB

unknownAllowances.reason: The price list has a separate Global-DataTransfer-Regional-Bytes line at $0 "under the monthly global free tier" for the first GB. Whether and how it applies to a given account was not determined, so none is applied.

title.ja: Distributed SQL: 3 ノードで、毎秒 10 件の書き込みを 1 か月
title.en: Distributed SQL: three nodes taking 10 writes a second for a month

ja: `-c nodes=3`、t4g.medium を 3 台、730 時間
ルートボリュームは 8 GiB と仮定（AMI が決める。実際の大きさは確かめていない）。データボリュームは 1 台 20 GiB。どちらも gp3 で、追加料金のかからない IOPS とスループットの範囲
11章のネットワークを 3 つのゾーンで作り、Systems Manager のインターフェースエンドポイント 3 つ（ssm、ssmmessages、ec2messages）を 3 つのゾーンに置いたまま
CPU クレジットは standard なので、ベースラインを超えた分の課金はない
バケットには、ノード用のアーカイブ 0.48 GB だけ
毎秒 10 件の書き込みが 730 時間。1 件が複製で運ぶ量を 2,000 バイトと仮定（測っていない）
tablet のリーダーは、別のゾーンにいる 2 つのフォロワーへ書き込みを送る。ゾーンをまたぐ転送は送る側と受ける側の両方で計量されるので、1 バイトが 4 回数えられる
ハートビート、トランザクションの状態の記録、別のゾーンのリーダーへ回される読み取り、クライアントとノードのあいだの転送は入れていない。実際はこれより多い
en: `-c nodes=3`: three t4g.medium running for 730 hours
The root volume is assumed to be 8 GiB (the AMI decides; the real size was not checked). Each data volume is 20 GiB. Both are gp3 within the IOPS and throughput that carry no extra charge
The chapter 11 network deployed with three zones, with three Systems Manager interface endpoints (ssm, ssmmessages, ec2messages) left in all three
CPU credits are in standard mode, so nothing is billed above the baseline
The bucket holds only the 0.48 GB archive for the nodes
10 writes a second for 730 hours. Each is assumed to carry 2,000 bytes through replication (not measured)
A tablet leader sends each write to its two followers in the other zones. A transfer between zones is metered at the sending and the receiving end, so each byte is counted four times
Heartbeats, transaction status records, reads forwarded to a leader in another zone, and traffic between clients and nodes are not included. The real figure is higher

records.command: vp run distsql:local:start, then vp run distsql:local:verify (no TLS, 2 runs)

note.ja: 127.0.0.1 の上で yb-master と yb-tserver を 3 組起動（PostgreSQL 15.12-YB-2025.2.7.0-b0）。13章のマイグレーション 4 つと repository を変えずに実行。上限 3 件に 12 件の作成を 3 ノードから同時に送り、2 回とも作成 3、quota_exceeded 9、note_count と行数が 3 で一致。40001 による再試行は 16 回と 4 回。ノード b を SIGKILL した後も a と c が確認済みの 40 件をすべて返し、続く 20 件の作成は 1.1 秒と 0.9 秒で終わった。b と c を落とすと残る 1 ノードは書き込みを確認せず（20 秒の無応答、接続のタイムアウト）、戻すと確認済みの 40 件がすべて残っていた。確認されなかった 1 件は、1 回目は入っていて、2 回目は入っていなかった。2 回目は ysql_dump の出力を別のデータベースに流し込み、40 件が揃った
note.en: Three pairs of yb-master and yb-tserver on 127.0.0.1 (PostgreSQL 15.12-YB-2025.2.7.0-b0). Chapter 13's four migrations and its repository ran unchanged. Twelve creates at once through three nodes against a quota of 3: in both runs 3 created, 9 quota_exceeded, note_count and the rows agreeing at 3. 16 and 4 retries after 40001. After SIGKILL of node b, a and c returned all 40 acknowledged notes, and the next 20 creates took 1.1 s and 0.9 s. With b and c down, the one node left acknowledged no write (no answer for 20 s; a timeout on connect); with them back, all 40 acknowledged notes were there. The unacknowledged write was there after the first run and not after the second. In the second run a ysql_dump fed into another database held all 40

records.command: vp run distsql:local:certs, vp run distsql:local:start --tls, then vp run distsql:local:verify (TLS, 5 runs, 1 failed)

note.ja: openssl（Homebrew の 3.6.1。この実行の時点では、Nix の shell には入っていなかった）で CA と 127.0.0.1 の証明書を作り、TLS とパスワード認証を有効にして同じ検証を 5 回実行。TLS なしのクライアントは断られた。40001 による再試行は 12、12、12、26、29 回。b を失った後の 20 件は 1.1 秒から 4.3 秒。2 ノードを失ったときの 1 件は確認されず、戻した後に入っていたのは 5 回のうち 2 回。3 回目の実行は、2 ノードを戻した直後の CREATE DATABASE が『current transaction is expired or aborted』で失敗し、検証が失敗で終わった。バックアップの段に再試行を入れた後の 2 回は通った。ysql_dump の出力は 4 回、別のデータベースに揃って入った。yb-admin は --certs_dir_name を付けると list_all_masters と modify_placement_info に応え、付けないと 60 秒でリーダーを見つけられずに終わった。検証の後、distsql:local:destroy で全プロセスを止めた
note.en: With a CA and a certificate for 127.0.0.1 made by openssl (Homebrew's 3.6.1; the Nix shell had none at the time of this run), and TLS and password authentication on, the same verification ran five times. A client without TLS was refused. 12, 12, 12, 26, and 29 retries after 40001. The 20 creates after losing b took 1.1 s to 4.3 s. The one create with two nodes lost was never acknowledged, and was there afterwards in 2 runs of 5. The third run ended in failure: the CREATE DATABASE right after the two nodes returned failed with "current transaction is expired or aborted". The two runs after a retry was added to the backup block passed. A ysql_dump fed into another database held everything in 4 runs. yb-admin answered list_all_masters and modify_placement_info with --certs_dir_name, and without it gave up after 60 s without finding the leader. After the verification, distsql:local:destroy stopped every process

note.ja: ノードに触るタスクは実行していない
note.en: No task that touches the nodes was run

note.ja: flake.nix の devShell に `pkgs.openssl` を足したあと、`nix develop` の中で実行した。`openssl version` は OpenSSL 3.5.8。`.yugabyte/ca` と `.yugabyte/certs` に以前の実行の証明書が残っていたので、タスクは何も作らずに終了コード 0 で終わった。別に、`src/certs.ts` の `caArgs`、`requestArgs`、`extensionsFor`、`signArgs` を同じ順で、リポジトリの外の空のディレクトリに対して devShell の openssl で実行し、`openssl verify` が OK を返すこと、証明書の subject が CN=127.0.0.1、subjectAltName が IP Address:127.0.0.1 であることを確かめた。クラスターは起動していない
note.en: Run inside `nix develop` after `pkgs.openssl` was added to the devShell in flake.nix. `openssl version` printed OpenSSL 3.5.8. `.yugabyte/ca` and `.yugabyte/certs` still held the certificates of an earlier run, so the task made nothing and exited 0. Separately, `caArgs`, `requestArgs`, `extensionsFor` and `signArgs` of `src/certs.ts` were run in the same order with the devShell's openssl against an empty directory outside the repository: `openssl verify` answered OK, and the certificate has the subject CN=127.0.0.1 and the subjectAltName IP Address:127.0.0.1. No cluster was started

summary.ja: 66章のスタックをデプロイしていない。EC2 の上では YugabyteDB を一度も起動していない。
summary.en: The chapter 66 stack was never deployed. YugabyteDB was never started on EC2.

resume.ja: 11章のネットワークを 3 ゾーンで作り、`vp run distsql:infra:deploy -c nodes=3`、続けて deploy のページの順に `distsql:artifact`、`distsql:install`、`distsql:certs`、`distsql:configure`、`distsql:start`、`distsql:health` を実行する。終わったら `distsql:infra:destroy` とボリュームの削除まで行う。
resume.en: Deploy the chapter 11 network with three zones, run `vp run distsql:infra:deploy -c nodes=3`, then, in the order of the deploy page, `distsql:artifact`, `distsql:install`, `distsql:certs`, `distsql:configure`, `distsql:start`, `distsql:health`. Finish with `distsql:infra:destroy` and delete the volumes.

summary.ja: ノード用のアーカイブ（el8-aarch64）を取得も実行もしていない。Amazon Linux 2023（arm64）の t4g.medium で動くこと、post_install.sh が通ること、systemd の設定と user data のスクリプトが実機で通ることは未確認。
summary.en: The archive for the nodes (el8-aarch64) was neither downloaded nor run. That it runs on Amazon Linux 2023 (arm64) on a t4g.medium, that post_install.sh succeeds, and that the systemd units and user data scripts work on a real machine are unconfirmed.

resume.ja: `vp run distsql:fetch --nodes` で取得して SHA-256 を照合し、デプロイしたノードで `vp run distsql:install` と `vp run distsql:status` を実行する。
resume.en: Fetch it with `vp run distsql:fetch --nodes` to check the SHA-256, then run `vp run distsql:install` and `vp run distsql:status` on deployed nodes.

summary.ja: ローリングアップグレード、死んだノードの置き換え（新しいアドレスのマスターと tablet server を足して古いものを外す手順）、snapshot を使ったバックアップは、文書の手順を写しただけで、手元でも実行していない。
summary.en: The rolling upgrade, the replacement of a dead node (adding a master and a tablet server at a new address and removing the old ones), and snapshot-based backups are copied from the documentation and were not run, locally or anywhere.

resume.ja: 手元のクラスターで 4 つ目のノードを別のポートで起動し、文書の `change_master_config` と `change_blacklist` の手順を実行する。アップグレードは、v2025.2 の 1 つ前のパッチ版を取得して同じ手順で試す。
resume.en: On the local cluster, start a fourth node on other ports and run the documented `change_master_config` and `change_blacklist` steps. For the upgrade, fetch the previous v2025.2 patch release and follow the same page.

summary.ja: 文書の「Start YB-TServers」のページを読めなかった（取得ツールが別のページの内容を返した）。yb-tserver のフラグは、固定した版のバイナリの --helpfull と、手元で起動できた事実で確かめた。
summary.en: The documentation's "Start YB-TServers" page could not be read (the fetch tool returned another page's content). The yb-tserver flags were confirmed from --helpfull of the pinned binary and from the fact that the local cluster started with them.

resume.ja: https://docs.yugabyte.com/stable/deploy/manual-deployment/start-tservers/ をブラウザで開き、`src/topology.ts` のフラグと、起動後の配置の設定（`yb-admin modify_placement_info`）の説明を照らし合わせる。
resume.en: Open https://docs.yugabyte.com/stable/deploy/manual-deployment/start-tservers/ in a browser and compare it with the flags in `src/topology.ts` and with the placement step after start (`yb-admin modify_placement_info`).

summary.ja: devShell に OpenSSL 3.5.8 を足し、`distsql:local:certs` と同じ引数で認証局と証明書を作れることは確かめた。TLS を有効にしたクラスターの検証（5 回）は Homebrew の OpenSSL 3.6.1 で作った証明書で実行したもので、3.5.8 で作った証明書ではクラスターを起動していない。`distsql:certs`（AWS のノード向け）は実行していない。
summary.en: OpenSSL 3.5.8 was added to the devShell, and the arguments of `distsql:local:certs` were confirmed to produce a certificate authority and a certificate with it. The verification of a cluster with TLS (5 runs) used certificates made by Homebrew's OpenSSL 3.6.1; no cluster was started with certificates made by 3.5.8. `distsql:certs` (for the nodes on AWS) was not run.

resume.ja: `vp run distsql:local:destroy` のあと `examples/66-distributed-sql/.yugabyte/ca` と `.yugabyte/certs` を消し、devShell の中で `vp run distsql:local:certs`、`vp run distsql:local:start --tls`、`vp run distsql:local:verify` を実行して、結果を記録する。
resume.en: After `vp run distsql:local:destroy`, delete `examples/66-distributed-sql/.yugabyte/ca` and `.yugabyte/certs`, then run `vp run distsql:local:certs`, `vp run distsql:local:start --tls` and `vp run distsql:local:verify` inside the devShell and record the result.

summary.ja: デッドロック（SQLSTATE 40P01）を実際のクラスターで起こしていない。13章の再試行ループは 40001 だけを再試行する。証明書の入れ替えの手順は、手動デプロイ向けの文書に見つけられなかった。
summary.en: A deadlock (SQLSTATE 40P01) was not produced on the real cluster. Chapter 13's retry loop retries 40001 only. No certificate rotation procedure for manual deployments was found in the documentation.

resume.ja: 2 つのトランザクションに 2 つの行を逆の順で更新させて 40P01 を観測し、再試行の条件に足すかを決める。証明書は、同じ CA で作り直したものを 1 ノードずつ置いて再起動し、接続が保たれるかを手元のクラスターで確かめる。
resume.en: Make two transactions update two rows in opposite orders to observe 40P01, and decide whether to add it to the retry predicate. For certificates, reissue under the same CA, replace and restart one node at a time on the local cluster, and see whether connections hold.

summary.ja: ゾーンをまたぐ転送量は、1 件 2,000 バイトという仮定からの計算で、測っていない。t4g.medium 3 台が毎秒 10 件の書き込みと 90 件の読み取りをさばけるかも測っていない。
summary.en: The cross-zone transfer is computed from an assumed 2,000 bytes per write, not measured. Whether three t4g.medium carry 10 writes and 90 reads a second was not measured either.

resume.ja: デプロイしたクラスターに負荷をかけ、各ノードの CloudWatch の NetworkOut と、Cost Explorer の DataTransfer-Regional-Bytes を読む。
resume.en: Put load on a deployed cluster and read each node's NetworkOut in CloudWatch and DataTransfer-Regional-Bytes in Cost Explorer.
